policy: A row records the relationship between document families. resolved means the boundary is documented; guarded means a source conflict is known and cannot be promoted; blocked means a user or primary-source decision is required.

rows.relationship: Phase1 is faithful-restoration/reference work; Phase2 is a new Reforge architecture and must not inherit old module coupling or fidelity as its implementation contract.
rows.stopLine: Do not cite Phase1 architecture as the current Phase2 design without an explicit Phase2 decision.

rows.relationship: Phase1 event/save contracts provide transferable knowledge, but Phase2 canonical schema/save semantics are independently governed.
unresolved: A current implementation-level one-to-one field mapping is not established by document reading alone.
rows.stopLine: No migration or compatibility claim may be made from this row without current code, schema and save evidence.

rows.relationship: Phase1 plans/status snapshots are historical evidence; Ops board/task status is the current responsibility surface.
rows.stopLine: A historical M0-M7 completion line cannot close a current Ops task.

rows.relationship: Lore is source-labelled author reference; Phase2 may consume only confirmed claims and must preserve ⚠/❓ and version boundaries.
unresolved: Several later-series and resurrection details remain source-questioned; they are not publication contracts.
rows.stopLine: Do not convert a lore draft, fan source or version-specific ending into canonical content without author adjudication.

rows.relationship: DLC-01 is a narrative draft/idea; Phase3 files are future roadmap/reference and neither authorizes current runtime implementation.
rows.stopLine: Keep all Guijie beats and Phase3 backlog items draft until a scoped product task and user decision promotes them.

rows.relationship: Ops documents describe work, evidence and claims; only current callers, executable tests and business oracles can establish runtime/test results.
unresolved: Static content review does not re-run every historical command or re-validate every old artifact.
rows.stopLine: Do not promote a historical receipt, coverage number, screenshot or task status to current quality proof.

rows.relationship: All 563 governed materials have one stable type/template binding; existing bodies remain governed legacy, while new documents must be template-compliant.
unresolved: Body rewrites for legacy records are intentionally not performed in bulk; a future migration task must preserve history and links.
rows.stopLine: No new independent document style or unregistered type may enter the governed roots.
